description:
Location:
 Remote – U.S. (working hours will be EDT time zone)

Compensation:
We feel passionately about transparency in compensation. Total compensation for this role is market competitive, offering a base salary range of $161,000-261,000 OTE.

About the Role

At Snappy, we believe meaningful connections start with showing appreciation. We’re looking to connect with Account Managers who are excited to help customers grow their impact through gifting, recognition, rewards, and engagement.

As an Account Manager, you’ll manage and grow relationships with existing customers, helping them discover new ways to use Snappy across their organizations. You’ll lead commercial conversations, identify opportunities for expansion, and develop account strategies that support long-term customer success.

You’ll partner closely with our Customer Success team and other internal partners to understand customer goals, identify opportunities, and deliver a thoughtful customer experience.

This is an evergreen opportunity. We’re building a pipeline of Account Management talent across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise for roles that may become available as our team grows. The timing of openings and next steps may vary based on business needs.

You Will:

  • Own a portfolio of customer accounts, with a focus on retention and revenue growth.

  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across customer organizations and understand their goals and priorities.

  • Develop account plans that identify risks, opportunities, and paths to long-term growth.

  • Lead commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing, and expansion opportunities.

  • Identify new use cases across gifting, rewards, recognition, onboarding, incentives, and swag.

  • Partner with Customer Success and cross-functional teams to align on customer needs and remove blockers.

  • Help customers discover relevant platform capabilities, integrations, and automated programs.

  • Maintain accurate account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts in Salesforce or a similar CRM.

  • Use modern tools, including AI where appropriate, to support account research, opportunity identification, and customer engagement.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, customer growth, sales, customer success, or a related customer-facing role in SaaS or technology.

  • Experience managing customer relationships and contributing to retention, expansion, or revenue growth.

  • A consultative approach to uncovering customer needs and connecting them to meaningful solutions.

  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

  • Experience managing multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Strong organization and operational discipline, including experience with a CRM such as Salesforce.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach and a strong sense of ownership.

 

Nice to have:

  • Experience managing complex accounts or working with stakeholders across multiple departments.

  • Experience leading strategic account planning or executive-level customer conversations.

  • Familiarity with gifting, rewards, recognition, employee engagement, or related platforms.

 

Snappy is the award-winning, all-in-one gifting company that spreads joy, shares gratitude, and takes the guesswork out of gifting.

Founded in 2015, Snappy was named one of Inc.’s fastest-growing companies in the Northeast in 2021, 2022, and 2023. Snappy is the trusted gifting and swag partner to over 43% of Fortune 100 companies as well as thousands of individuals who use Snappy for personal gifting. Snappy has sent more than five million gifts worldwide.

Snappy thrives on connecting people and cultivating meaningful relationships through the power of gratitude and gifting. Our recipient-picks experience ensures gift-givers send the perfect gift every time, for everyone, on every occasion.Snappy has been featured on Fortune’s "Best Small & Medium Workplaces," “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplace in Tech” lists.

We've seen firsthand that our unique product and brand experience boosts employee morale, improves performance, and (most importantly!) spreads joy, so, of course, we practice what we preach! Here at Snappy, we believe wholeheartedly in building a culture of appreciation, dedication, and fun. We offer benefits and perks to our employees including but not limited to: Free healthcare, including vision and dental, generous 401k match, flexible PTO, paid family leave, Snappy Summer Fridays (which we enjoy year-round!) and Snappy gifts for employee recognition and appreciation.

Snappy's stance on diversity, equity and inclusion, its active focus on give-back programs, and its fundamental mission to spread joy through the power of gifting all lead the way in unlocking the power of human kindness at work.

Snappy is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Snappy provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and employment process. If you need an accommodation to participate in the hiring process, please contact hanna.tsyrlin@snappy.com.

Information collected and processed as part of your Snappy hiring process, including as part of your Snappy career profile and in any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to Snappy Recruitment Privacy Notice
